title: Construct collections with deliberate capacity and comparison

evidence.scope: Actual comparer-sensitive lookup/addition, list order/duplicates and capacity, custom configured/default builder overloads, escaped with invocation and indexer read/write/rejection checks.
Actual comparer-sensitive lookup/addition, list order/duplicates and capacity, custom configured/default builder overloads, escaped with invocation and indexer read/write/rejection checks.

goal: Use collection-expression arguments when constructor or builder configuration must accompany the elements. Preserve capacity, ordering and comparison semantics.

selectionNotes: Keep the original comparer and element semantics; capacity is storage headroom, not Count.
Use a first-position with element and a supported constructor or builder overload.
Escape @with(...) when invoking a method to produce an element.

constraints: Arrays and spans do not support a with element; dynamic arguments are unsupported.
Read-only sequence interfaces accept only an empty with element; ICollection<T>/IList<T> additionally accept capacity.
Builder configuration parameters precede the final ReadOnlySpan<T>; preserve overload defaults.
CollectionLike demonstrates constructor and custom string-builder forms, not arbitrary third-party builders.
